title: 98Token — Analysis of Public Swap Function Without Access Control
root_cause: `swapTokensForTokens()` has no access control, allowing anyone to swap tokens held by the contract
steps: → [1] Check token_98 balance held by vulnerable contract
→ [3] Execute token_98 → USDT swap from contract holdings
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] Check token_98 balance held by vulnerable contract
  │
  ├─→ [2] Directly call swapTokensForTokens()
  │         ├─ path: [token_98, USDT]
  │         ├─ amountIn: entire contract balance
  │         ├─ amountOutMin: 0
  │         └─ recipient: attacker's address
  │
  ├─→ [3] Execute token_98 → USDT swap from contract holdings
  │
  └─→ [4] Receive 28,000 USDT
